title: Lunar AeroLabs Announces Navigraph Partnership and Official LAGF800 SimBrief Profile
summary: Lunar AeroLabs has announced a significant new milestone in the development of its LAGF800 ultra-long-range business jet for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, confirming an official partnership with Navigraph and the availability of a dedicated SimBrief aircraft profile.
body:
The announcement was made by CaptainLunar on the developer's official Discord server on 29 October 2026, marking another step forward for the ambitious business aviation project.

## Official Navigraph Partnership

Lunar AeroLabs confirmed that it has officially partnered with Navigraph, the well-known provider of aviation navigation data, charts and flight-planning services.

The announcement represents an important development for the LAGF800 project, which aims to deliver a detailed ultra-long-range business jet experience for MSFS 2024.

Although the partnership has been announced, Lunar AeroLabs has not yet provided a detailed breakdown of which Navigraph services will be integrated directly into the aircraft's avionics or electronic flight bag.

## LAGF800 SimBrief Aircraft Profile Now Available

Alongside the partnership announcement, Lunar AeroLabs revealed that an official LAGF800 aircraft profile is now available for SimBrief.

This allows flight simulation enthusiasts to begin planning LAGF800 operations before the aircraft itself is released, using a dedicated profile containing flight-planning, fuel calculation and aircraft performance information.

For those interested in long-range business aviation, the addition is particularly relevant. Accurate fuel planning, flight duration estimates and aircraft performance figures are important considerations when preparing intercontinental flights.

The new profile also provides enthusiasts with an opportunity to explore the aircraft's intended operational capabilities while development continues.

![](/assets/image.png)

## Another Step Forward for the LAGF800

The announcement follows Lunar AeroLabs' recent development updates showcasing progress on the LAGF800's exterior modelling, cockpit, custom avionics and aircraft systems.

The project remains in development for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, with the developer previously targeting the third quarter of 2027 for release.

No revised release date was announced as part of the Navigraph partnership news.

## BizJet Pilot's View

The Navigraph partnership and release of an official SimBrief profile are encouraging developments for the LAGF800.

While neither announcement confirms that the aircraft is nearing release, both demonstrate progress beyond visual modelling towards the operational experience that long-range business jet enthusiasts will expect.

It will be particularly interesting to see how Lunar AeroLabs incorporates Navigraph-supported flight planning into its custom avionics and cockpit systems as development progresses.

BizJet Pilot will continue following the LAGF800 project and reporting on further announcements.

**Sources:** Lunar AeroLabs official Discord, `#announcements`, CaptainLunar, 29 October 2026; [Navigraph SimBrief](https://www.simbrief.com/).
